faqs.a: DialogHive is an AI chatbot agency platform. We build and manage AI chatbots that talk to your customers on WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DM and your website — all from one system, with your business data powering every answer.

faqs.q: Which channels do DialogHive chatbots support?
faqs.a: One bot works everywhere: the official WhatsApp Cloud API, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DM, and an embeddable website chat widget that installs with a single script tag.

faqs.q: How long does it take to launch a chatbot?
faqs.a: Most businesses go live within a few days. We onboard your business data, connect your channels, test the bot with you, and launch — no coding needed on your side.

faqs.q: Can the chatbot hand over to a human agent?
faqs.a: Yes. Hybrid mode combines AI answers with human takeover, so your team can step into any conversation from the client portal whenever a customer needs personal attention.

faqs.q: Does DialogHive work for my industry?
faqs.a: We have industry-trained bots for restaurants, e-commerce stores, hospitals, salons, schools, real estate, fintech and car workshops — plus a fully custom AI mode for any other business.
Plans start at $49/month and scale with your channels and message volume. See the Pricing page for full details, or contact us for a custom quote.
